answers.question: What would you want to know before this change starts?
answers.answer: I’d want to know if the new June window triggers a full evaluation cycle or relies on existing performance data, as that impacts our workload. I also need clarity on whether the published criteria will be rigid checklists or flexible guidelines, so I can plan my contributions effectively.

answers.question: Which part of this proposal is least clear to you?
answers.answer: While the June window and IC3-to-IC4 criteria are well-defined, it remains unclear how this transparency will extend to other levels, particularly IC1 and IC2 where I operate. Without a roadmap for publishing criteria across the entire individual contributor ladder, the proposal feels like a partial solution that may leave most of my cohort in the dark. I need to know if this is a pilot for full-scale transparency or just a targeted fix for senior roles.

answers.question: What would you want to know before this change starts?
answers.answer: I need to see a concrete career progression framework that explicitly addresses how ICs will navigate promotions without getting lost in the merged hierarchy. Specifically, how will the new director ensure that the 70% of us below midpoint get equitable access to growth opportunities rather than facing further stagnation? Without defined paths for advancement, I fear this consolidation will just bury our career trajectories under administrative complexity.

answers.question: Which part of this proposal is least clear to you?
answers.answer: I am unclear on how the new directive will balance the distinct operational priorities of infrastructure scalability with data governance requirements. Specifically, I want to know if there will be dedicated ownership for data integrity standards or if they will be subsumed under general platform concerns. Without clarity on this split, I worry about the potential dilution of specialized focus.
